title: Combined Weekly Visit Caps Across Appointment Series Sharing One Funding Holding
content:
**Desk guidance — Patient Services Center.** Where more than one Appointment Series is paid for by the same funding holding, their weekly appointments are looked at together.

**The rule.** The standing appointments per week of all booked, active or paused series funded by the same holding are added together. For series funded by one Insured Plan of Care the total may not exceed that plan's maximum visits per week; for series funded by one Workers' Compensation Referral it may not exceed that referral's authorized visits per week; for a Self-Pay Visit Package or a Wellness Membership no combined cap applies. Each series on its own keeps its standing appointments per week between the minimum and the maximum for its visit format.

**By funding holding.**

| Funding holding of the series | Combined weekly total compared with |
|---|---|
| One Insured Plan of Care | that plan's maximum visits per week |
| One Workers' Compensation Referral | that referral's authorized visits per week |
| One Self-Pay Visit Package | no combined cap |
| One Wellness Membership | no combined cap |

**Worked readings (hypothetical figures).**

- A patient has a Standard 45-Minute Visit Series at 2 a week and an Aquatic Therapy Visit Series at 1 a week, both funded by one Insured Plan of Care whose maximum is 3 visits a week. The combined total is 3, which does not exceed the plan's maximum. Raising the standard series to 3 a week would bring the total to 4 and exceed it.
- Two series funded by one Self-Pay Visit Package are not held to a combined weekly cap, but each still stays within the weekly range of its own format.
- A paused series still counts toward the combined total; a completed or cancelled one does not.
